recommendations.title: Publish the new iOS subtitle and Play short description together
recommendations.detail: Publish Verification still reads the old texts live: iOS subtitle "Relaxing Brain Game" and Play short "Relaxing ocean block puzzle…". Neither contains "tile match" — your best-converting term (GB #4, US #9). Ship both in the same release so the next scan can attribute any rank change to this one edit.
recommendations.source: Claude — 2 Nov 2026, publish verification + keyword matrix

recommendations.title: Ship the pt-BR store listing before the next scan
recommendations.detail: BR has the highest average keyword volume of the markets without a local listing (52/100) and two breakable tops: "wood block puzzle" BR — you #29 with no top-3 app above 94 ratings — and "sudoku blocks" BR, where you already sit at #2 (was #9). The pt-BR pack in the Localization tab is ready; screenshot headings still need a fifth line.
recommendations.source: Claude — 2 Nov 2026, country volume vs. live languages

recommendations.title: Move the review prompt to the end of a 3-day Daily Tide streak
recommendations.detail: The prompt fired on first launch: 3-5 iOS ratings per week. After moving it to a streak-completion moment, iOS ratings went 371 → 412 in one week (largest weekly jump in the history table). Keep it there and add the same trigger on Android via the In-App Review API.

recommendations.title: Answer the 14 unanswered 1-2★ Play reviews about the ad after level 3
recommendations.detail: Play rating is 4.5 vs 4.6 on iOS with 3x the rating mass; the gap traces to one complaint cluster (interstitial after level 3). Reply with the fix shipped in 1.4.2 and ask for a re-rate — answered negatives are frequently revised upward.

recommendations.title: Keep "relaxing" in the keyword field — do not chase "relaxing games" in the title
recommendations.detail: "relaxing games" has the highest volume after "brain games" (70/100 US) but difficulty 68 and you sit at #88, behind apps with 70k-100k ratings. The title slot is worth more on "block puzzle" (US #41 → realistic top 20). Revisit when iOS ratings pass 2,000.

recommendations.title: Re-cut the German keyword field: "tile match" DE fell #18 → #31
recommendations.detail: The DE listing is live but its keyword field is a literal translation ("Fliesen" = bathroom tiles). German players search "Kacheln", "Steine" and "Klötze"; the top-3 DE app "Kachel Kombi" uses "Kachel" in its title. The updated de pack swaps these in; the drop started the week Mosaic Match 3D localized into German.

recommendations.title: Fix the es-MX and ja packs before export — the audit flags them
recommendations.detail: Localization Audit: es-MX keyword field has spaces after commas (wasted characters) and repeats "bloques" from the title; the ja screenshot headings contain a Latin word. Both are flagged in the audit card; fix, then run export_metadata.py --check.

recommendations.title: Cut a 20-second "satisfying clear" short around the Daily Tide
recommendations.detail: "tile match" and "sudoku blocks" are your two strongest terms by score (41.0 and 42.6) and both are visual: a full-board clear reads in one second. Use the Video SEO tag set from this scan; title template 1 already carries the brand + top term.

recommendations.title: Work "jigsaw" and "daily challenge" into the Play long description
recommendations.detail: Both are opportunity tags in the matrix ("daily challenge" is used by 5 of 6 competitors, 2 in titles) and both describe features you actually have (Daily Tide, picture boards). Play indexes the long description; iOS does not, so this is a Play-only edit.

recommendations.title: Watch Zen Grid Puzzle on "sudoku blocks": #1 in DE, BR and MX
recommendations.detail: Zen Grid has only 3,120 iOS ratings yet holds #1 in three markets on your best term — it is winning on title match ("Zen Grid: Sudoku Blocks"), not on rating mass. If it localizes into Portuguese first, the BR #2 position is at risk.

recommendations.title: Stop the Instagram test; double the TikTok creative that worked
recommendations.detail: Campaign log: ig_story_test $180 → 63 installs (CPI $2.86) vs tiktok_satisfying_a $120 → 131 installs (CPI $0.92). Same budget week, same store page — the difference is the creative and the channel. Reuse the satisfying-clear clip as the next ad.

recommendations.title: Decide on an In-App Event for the December "Winter Tide" boards
recommendations.detail: No competitor in the radar currently runs an event card on your terms. The Winter Tide boards ship in 1.5; an event card is a second search listing for free. Decide by 20 Nov — events need review time.

asoSuggestions.reason: Unchanged and verified live. Rejected "Tidal Tiles: Wood Block Puzzle" (30/30): "wood" is already carried by the subtitle and the extra word would dilute "block puzzle", the highest-volume term (78 US).

Covers three radar targets in 24 characters with no token repeated from the title. Rejected the live "Relaxing Brain Game": "brain games" is difficulty 76 and you are #38 behind a 240k-rating app, while "tile match" is already top 10 in US/GB.

No spaces, no repeats, nothing from title/subtitle. Competitor brand terms (brickfall, cubeway) deliberately left out even though the tag matrix flags them — brand bidding in metadata is a review risk for little gain.

asoSuggestions.value: New: Winter Tide boards arrive in December — 30 frosty puzzles, the same calm rules. Update now and keep your Daily Tide streak going.
asoSuggestions.reason: Promotional text is not indexed and can change without review — used for the next event, not for keywords.

asoSuggestions.value:
Tidal Tiles is a calm wood block puzzle that plays like a breath of sea air.

Drop wooden tiles onto the grid, fill rows, columns and 3x3 squares, and watch the tide wash them away. No timer, no lives, no pressure — just you, the board and the sound of waves.

WHY PLAYERS STAY
• Classic block puzzle rules with a sudoku twist: clear squares, not just lines
• Play offline — no wifi needed on the train, on a plane or at the beach
• Daily Tide: one new hand-made board every day
• 300+ calm levels that slowly teach smarter moves
• Soft ocean sounds and haptics you can turn off

A brain game for adults who want to unwind, not to grind. Easy to learn, satisfying to master.

Tidal Tiles is free to play. Optional ads can be removed with a one-time purchase.
asoSuggestions.reason: Unchanged — live and verified. iOS does not index the description; it is written for conversion, and the first two lines are what shows above "more".

asoSuggestions.value:
Tidal Tiles is a relaxing wood block puzzle with an ocean soul.

Place wooden blocks on the board, complete rows, columns and 3x3 squares, and let the tide clear them. There is no timer and no stress: every board can be solved at your own pace.

★ Wood block puzzle meets sudoku — clear squares as well as lines
★ Offline games done right: play anywhere, no internet connection needed
★ Daily Tide challenge: a fresh board every day, the same for every player
★ 300+ calm levels, from a gentle start to real brain teasers
★ Soothing waves, soft haptics, a dark mode for evening sessions

Made for adults who want a short, calm break — a block puzzle that trains your brain without shouting at you.

Free to play. Remove ads with a single purchase. No subscriptions.
